question: Which distribution shape has the bars monotonically increase in height from left to right?
model_answer: None of the distribution shapes have bars that monotonically increase in height from left to right. However, the distribution shape that is closest to this description is the one labeled "Decreasing" when viewed in reverse order, but if we are to choose from the given options, the closest is the first unlabeled distribution. The bars in this distribution increase in height from left to right.
